name: Philly Cheesesteak
desc: Ribeye, caramelized onions and provolone on a garlic-buttered hoagie

ingredients.raw: 1 lb ribeye steak, trimmed and thinly sliced
1/2 tsp sea salt, or to taste
1/2 tsp black pepper, or to taste

steps: Toast the buns: mix the softened butter with the pressed garlic, spread on the cut sides of the hoagie rolls, and toast on a skillet or griddle over medium heat until golden. Set aside.
Caramelize the onions: add 1 tbsp of the oil to the pan and saute the diced onion until softened. Salt lightly and keep cooking until caramelized, then transfer to a bowl.
Cook the steak: raise the heat to high and add the remaining oil. Spread the sliced ribeye in an even layer and let it brown undisturbed for a couple of minutes.
Flip, season with the salt and pepper, and saute until cooked through, then stir the caramelized onions back in.
Melt the cheese: divide the meat into four piles, lay two slices of provolone over each, and cover briefly until melted.
Spread mayonnaise on the toasted rolls and scoop a pile of meat and cheese into each.
